Callbacks: ReadAt is invoked synchronously from Reader::read only; the test-side Probe::source() and Counting::source() are this-capturing callbacks whose Probe or Counting outlive every Reader and Source they feed (all call sites checked); the ELF fuzz flaky Source copies honest by value and is local to one call. Allocation sized by input is bounded before the allocation: Reader::read decides overflow, size and both budgets before read_at is called (largest observed allocation 512 KiB). Exceptions: only std::bad_alloc or a throwing caller-supplied read_at can escape read_*, and no state is left misusable. Resource Ledger (C++, verified by read and grep at 8606ad3ba5, restating the pass-1 text with the Reader and line references corrected): NO new owning raw resource. The readers (agents/shared/binary_header_{reader,pe,elf,macho}.hpp) and the three libFuzzer harnesses hold no fd, HANDLE, SOCKET, FILE*, sqlite or OpenSSL or BCrypt object, allocated C string, mapped library, temp path, subprocess or thread; no static or thread_local state (only static constexpr char kDigits[]); no manual cleanup. Owned values (RAII): Source (std::function plus size) copied by value into Reader, which keeps its copy for its own lifetime; the std::string buffers from Reader::read; the result structs' vectors and strings; the PE section vector; the VersionParser key and value strings. Reader is NOT copyable and not movable (binary_header_reader.hpp:107-108 delete the copy operations), so its budget counters have one owner; every use is a direct-initialised local passed by reference, and a copy fails to compile (tests/unit/test_binary_header_reader.cpp:27). Borrowed, non-owning: span_source captures a span over caller bytes (documented binary_header_reader.hpp:52-55); VersionParser holds a string_view over one blob string plus const PeLimits& and PeVersionInfo& (the temporary parser dies in the same full-expression, binary_header_pe.hpp:500-504); Mach-O area, head and c views are over locals that outlive each use; no view is stored in a result. Callbacks: ReadAt is invoked synchronously from Reader::read only; the test-side Probe::source() and Counting::source() are this-capturing callbacks whose owners outlive every Reader and Source they feed; the ELF fuzz flaky Source copies the honest Source by value and is local to one call. Casts: binary_header_reader.hpp:64 reinterpret_cast<const char*>(std::byte*), read-only and documented; reinterpret_cast<const std::byte*>(const uint8_t*) in the three harnesses (libFuzzer buffer, as fuzz_component_zip.cpp:18); three test casts at test_binary_header_reader.cpp:182, test_binary_header_macho.cpp:213 and test_binary_header_pe.cpp:66. Test-only I/O: std::ifstream in load_fixture (RAII, REQUIRE on a missing or empty file). Allocation sized by input is bounded before the allocation: Reader::read decides overflow, source size and both budgets before read_at is called (binary_header_reader.hpp:115-125; the largest default cap is 512 KiB, Mach-O load commands). Exceptions: only std::bad_alloc or a throwing caller-supplied read_at can escape read_*, and no state is left misusable.
